reason: Provides a describe_image tool that reads local image files and sends them to a configured multimodal model for text-based image analysis.

summaries.zh: 通过 describe_image 工具读取本地图片并调用指定的多模态模型返回文字分析结果。
summaries.en: Adds a describe_image tool that reads local images and returns text analysis from a specified multimodal model.

capabilities: Reads local PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF files
Stores image bytes through the attachment service
Sends image data to a named multimodal model route
Returns text generated from the image analysis
